text.am: የዳዊት ልጅ ሰሎሞን በመንግሥቱ በረታ፤ አምላኩም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ፥ እጅግም አገነነው።
text.en: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ለእስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ለሻለቆች፥ ለመቶ አለቆችም፥ ለፈራጆችም፥ በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ዘንድ ለነበሩ መሳፍንት ሁሉ፥ ለአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ተናገረ።
text.en: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ከእርሱም ጋር ጉባኤው ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ በምድረ በዳ የሠራው የእግዚአብሔር መገናኛ ድንኳን በዚያ ነበረና በገባዖን ወዳለው የኮረብታ መስገጃ ሄዱ።
text.en: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.

text.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ታቦት ግን ዳዊት በኢየሩሳሌም ድንኳን ተክሎለት ነበርና ዳዊት ከቂርያትይዓሪም ወዳዘጋጀለት ስፍራ አምጥቶት ነበር።
text.en: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

text.am: የሆርም ልጅ የኡሪ ልጅ ባስልኤል የሠራው የናስ መሠዊያ በዚያ በእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ፊት ነበረ፤ ሰሎሞንም ጉባኤውም ይህን ይፈልጉት ነበር።
text.en: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመገናኛው ድንኳን አጠገብ ወዳለው ወደ ናሱ መሠዊያ ወጣ፥ በዚያም አንድ ሺህ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አቀረበ።
text.en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

text.am: በዚያም ሌሊት እግዚአብሔር። ምን እንድሰጥህ ለምነኝ ሲል ለሰሎሞን ተገለጠ።
text.en: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ከአባቴ ከዳዊት ጋር ታላቅ ምሕረት አድርገሃል፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ አንግሠኸኛል።
text.en: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.

text.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ቍጥሩ እንደ ምድር ትቢያ በሆነው በብዙ ሕዝብ ላይ አንግሠኸኛልና ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የሰጠኸው ተስፋ ይጽና።
text.en: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

text.am: አሁንም በዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት እወጣና እገባ ዘንድ ጥበብንና እውቀትን ስጠኝ፤ ይህን በሚያህል በዚህ በታላቅ ሕዝብ ላይ ይፈርድ ዘንድ የሚችል የለምና።
text.en: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰሎሞንን። ይህ በልብህ ነበረና፥ ባለጠግነትንና ሀብትን ክብርንና የጠላቶችህን ነፍስ ረጅምም ዕድሜን አልለመንህምና፥ ነገር ግን ባነገሥሁህ በሕዝቤ ላይ ለመፍረድ ትችል ዘንድ ጥበብንና እውቀትን ለራስህ ለምነሃልና ጥበብንና እውቀትን ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤
text.en: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

text.am: ከአንተ በፊትም ከነበሩት ከአንተም በኋላ ከሚነሡት ነገሥታት አንድ ስንኳ የሚመስልህ እንዳይኖር ባለጠግነትንና ሀብትን ክብርንም እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።
text.en: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም በገባዖን ካለው ከኮረብታው መስገጃ ከመገናኛው ድንኳን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፤ በእስራኤልም ላይ ነገሠ።
text.en: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ሰረገሎቹንና ፈረሰኞችን ሰበሰበ፥ አንድ ሺህም አራት መቶ ሰረገሎች፥ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህም ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት፤ በሰረገሎች ከተሞችና ከእርሱ ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራቸው።
text.en: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

text.am: ንጉሡም ብሩንና ወርቁን በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ድንጋይ እንዲበዛ አደረገው፤ የዝግባም እንጨት ብዛት በቈላ እንደሚበቅል ሾላ ሆነ።
text.en: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ፈረሶችን ከግብጽና ከቀዌ አስመጣ፤ የንጉሡም ነጋዴዎች በገንዘብ እየገዙ ከቀዌ ያመጡአቸው ነበር።
text.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

text.am: አንዱም ሰረገላ በስድስት መቶ፥ አንዱም ፈረስ በመቶ አምሳ ሰቅል ብር ከግብጽ ይወጣ ነበር፤ እንዲሁም ለኬጢያውያንና ለሶሪያ ነገሥታት ሁሉ በእጃቸው ያመጡላቸው ነበር።
text.en: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት፥ ለመንግሥቱም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ አሰበ።
text.en: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም የሚሸከሙትን ሰባ ሺህ፥ ከተራሮችም የሚጠርቡትን ሰማኒያ ሺህ፥ በእነርሱም ላይ የተሾሙትን ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ሰዎች ቈጠረ።
text.en: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም እንዲህ ሲል ወደ ጢሮስ ንጉሥ ወደ ኪራም ላከ። ከአባቴ ከዳዊት ጋር እንዳደረግህ፥ የሚቀመጥበትንም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ የዝግባ እንጨት እንደ ሰደድህለት፥ እንዲሁ ለእኔ አድርግ።
text.en: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ለእስራኤል ለዘላለም እንደ ታዘዘው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የጣፋጩን ሽቱ ለማጠን፥ የገጹንም ኅብስት ለማኖር፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በጥዋትና በማታ በሰንበታቱም በመባቻዎቹም በአምላካችንም በእግዚአብሔር በዓላት ለማቅረብ ለአምላኬ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት እሠራና እቀድስ ዘንድ አሰብሁ።
text.en: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.

text.am: አምላካችንም ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ ታላቅ ነውና የምሠራው ቤት ታላቅ ነው።
text.en: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.

text.am: ነገር ግን ሰማይና ከሰማያት በላይ ያለ ሰማይ ይይዘው ዘንድ አይችልምና ለእርሱ ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ ማን ይችላል? በፊቱ ዕጣን ከማጠን በቀር ቤት እሠራለት ዘንድ እኔ ማን ነኝ?
text.en: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

text.am: አሁንም አባቴ ዳዊት ካዘጋጃቸው በእኔ ዘንድ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ካሉት ብልሃተኞች ጋር የሚሆን፥ ወርቁንና ብሩን፥ ናሱንና ብረቱን፥ ሐምራዊውንና ቀዩን ሰማያዊውንም ግምጃ የሚሠራ፥ ቅርጽንም የሚያውቅ ብልሃተኛ ሰው ላክልኝ።
text.en: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.

text.am: ደግሞም ባሪያዎችህ ከሊባኖስ እንጨት መቍረጥ እንዲያውቁ እኔ አውቃለሁና ከሊባኖስ የዝግባና የጥድ የሰንደልም እንጨት ስደድልኝ።
text.en: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,

text.am: የምሠራውም ቤት እጅግ ታላቅና ድንቅ ይሆናልና ብዙ እንጨት ያዘጋጁልኝ ዘንድ፥ እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር ይሆናሉ።
text.en: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.

text.am: እነሆም፥ እንጨቱን ለሚቈርጡ ለባሪያዎችህ ሀያ ሺህ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ የተበጠረ ስንዴ፥ ሀያ ሺህም የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ገብስ፥ ሀያ ሺህም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ የወይን ጠጅ፥ ሀያ ሺህም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ዘይት እሰጣለሁ።
text.en: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

text.am: የጢሮስ ንጉሥም ኪራም። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ወድዶአልና በላያቸው አነገሠህ ብሎ ለሰሎሞን መልእክት ላከ።
text.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.

text.am: ኪራምም ደግሞ አለ። ሰማይንና ምድርን የፈጠረ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለመንግሥቱም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ ጥበበኛና ብልሃተኛ አስተዋይም ልጅ ለንጉሡ ለዳዊት የሰጠ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ቡሩክ ይሁን።
text.en: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.

text.am: አሁንም ከብልሃተኞችህ ጋር ከጌታዬም ከአባትህ ከዳዊት ብልሃተኞች ጋር ይሆን ዘንድ ኪራምአቢ የሚባል ብልሃተኛና አስተዋይ ሰው ሰድጄልሃለሁ።
text.en: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,

text.am: እናቱ ከዳን ልጆች ናት፥ አባቱም የጢሮስ ሰው ነው፤ ወርቁንና ብሩንም፥ ናሱንና ብረቱን፥ ድንጋይንና እንጨቱን፥ ሐምራዊውንና ሰማያዊውን ቀዩንም ግምጃ፥ ጥሩውንም በፍታ ይሠራ ዘንድ፥ ቅርጽም ሌላም ነገር ሁሉ ያደርግ ዘንድ ያውቃል።
text.en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.

text.am: አሁንም ጌታዬ የተናገረውን ስንዴውንና ገብሱን ዘይቱንና የወይን ጠጁን ወደ ባሪያዎቹ ይስደድ፤
text.en: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:

text.am: እኛም ከሊባኖስ የምትሻውን ያህል እንጨት እንቈርጣለን፥ በታንኳም አድርገን በባሕር ላይ ወደ አንተ ወደ ኢዮጴ እንሰድዳለን፤ አንተም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ታስወስደዋለህ።
text.en: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም በእስራኤል ምድር የነበሩትን መጻተኞች ሁሉ አባቱ ዳዊት እንደ ቈጠራቸው ቈጠረ፤ መቶ አምሳ ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ተገኙ።
text.en: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.

text.am: ከእነርሱም የሚሸከሙትን ሰባ ሺህ፥ በተራሮችም ላይ የሚጠርቡትን ሰማንያ ሺህ፥ በሕዝቡም ሥራ ላይ የተሾሙትን ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ አደረገ።
text.en: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም እግዚአብሔር ለአባቱ ለዳዊት በተገለጠበት በሞሪያ ተራራ ዳዊት ባዘጋጀው ስፍራ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ በኢየሩሳሌም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት መሥራት ጀመረ።
text.en: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

text.am: በነገሠም በአራተኛው ዓመት በሁለተኛው ወር መሥራት ጀመረ።
text.en: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ የጣለው መሠረት ይህ ነው፤ ርዝመቱም በዱሮው ስፍር ስድሳ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ።
text.en: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

text.am: በቤቱም ፊት የነበረው ወለል ርዝመቱ እንደ ቤቱ ወርድ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም መቶ ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ፤ ውስጡንም በጥሩ ወርቅ ለበጠው።
text.en: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

text.am: ታላቁንም ቤት በጥድ እንጨት ከደነው፥ በጥሩም ወርቅ ለበጠው፤ የዘንባባና የሰንሰለት አምሳል ቀረጸበት።
text.en: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

text.am: ቤቱንም በዕንቍ አስጌጠው፤ ወርቁንም የፈርዋይም ወርቅ ነበረ።
text.en: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

text.am: ቤቱንም ሰረገሎቹንም መድረኮቹንም ግንቦቹንም ደጆቹንም በወርቅ ለበጠ፤ በግንቦቹም ላይ ኪሩቤልን ቀረጸ።
text.en: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.

text.am: ቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑንም ሠራ፤ ርዝመቱም እንደ ቤቱ ወርድ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ፤ ስድስት መቶ መክሊት በሚያህል በጥሩ ወርቅ ለበጠው።
text.en: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

text.am: የምስማሮቹም ሚዛን አምሳ ሰቅል ወርቅ ነበረ። የደርቡንም ጓዳዎች በወርቅ ለበጠ።
text.en: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

text.am: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳንም ውስጥ ከእንጨት ሥራ ሁለቱ ኪሩቤልን ሠራ፥ በወርቅም ለበጣቸው።
text.en: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.

text.am: የኪሩቤልም ክንፎች ሀያ ክንድ ሙሉ ተዘርግተው ነበር፤ የአንዱ ኪሩብ ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የቤቱንም ግንብ ይነካ ነበረ፤ ሁለተኛው ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የሁለተኛውንም ኪሩብ ክንፍ ይነካ ነበር።
text.en: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

text.am: የሁለተኛውም ኪሩብ ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የቤቱንም ግንብ ይነካ ነበር፤ ሁለተኛውም ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የሌላውንም ኪሩብ ክንፍ ይነካ ነበር።
text.en: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

text.am: የእነዚህም ኪሩቤል ክንፎች ሀያ ክንድ ሙሉ ተዘርግተው ነበር፤ በእግራቸውም ቆመው ነበር፥ ፊቶቻቸውም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለከቱ ነበር።
text.en: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.

text.am: ከሰማያዊውም ከሐምራዊውም ከቀዩም ሐር ከጥሩም በፍታ መጋረጃውን ሠራ፥ ኪሩቤልንም ጠለፈበት።
text.en: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.

text.am: በቤቱም ፊት ቁመታቸው ሠላሳ አምስት ክንድ የነበረውን ሁለቱን ዓምዶች ሠራ፥ በእያንዳንዳቸውም ላይ የነበረው ጕልላት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።
text.en: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

text.am: እንደ ድሪ ያሉ ሰንሰለቶችንም ሠርቶ በአዕማዱ ራስ ላይ አደረጋቸው፤ መቶም ሮማኖች ሠርቶ በሰንሰለቱ ላይ አደረጋቸው።
text.en: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

text.am: አዕማዶቹንም አንደኛውን በቀኝ፥ ሁለተኛውን በግራ በመቅደሱ ፊት አቆማቸው፤ በቀኝም የነበረውን ስም ያቁም በግራም የነበረውን ስም በለዝ ብሎ ጠራቸው።
text.en: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

text.am: ደግሞም ርዝመቱ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም አሥር ክንድ የነበረውን የናሱን መሠዊያ ሠራ።
text.en: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

text.am: ከፈሰሰም ናስ ከዳር እስከ ዳር አሥር ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም አምስት ክንድ፥ በዙሪያውም ሠላሳ ክንድ የሆነ ክብ ኵሬ ሠራ።
text.en: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

text.am: በበታቹም ለአንድ ክንድ አሥር፥ ለአንድም ክንድ አሥር፥ ጕብጕቦች አዞረበት፤ ኵሬውም በቀለጠ ጊዜ ጕብጕቦቹ በሁለት ተራ ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ቀልጠው ነበር።
text.en: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.

text.am: በአሥራ ሁለትም በሬዎች ምስል ላይ ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ ከእነርሱም ሦስቱ ወደ ሰሜን ሦስቱም ወደ ምዕራብ ሦስቱም ወደ ደቡብ ሦስቱም ወደ ምሥራቅ ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ ኵሬውም በላያቸው ነበር፥ የሁሉም ጀርባቸው በስተ ውስጥ ነበረ።
text.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

text.am: ውፍረቱም አንድ ጋት ያህል ነበረ፤ ከንፈሩም አንደ ጽዋ ከንፈር፥ እንደ ሱፍ አበባ ሆኖ ተሠርቶ ነበር፤ ሦስት ሺህም የባዶስ መሥፈሪያ ይይዝ ነበር።
text.en: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.

text.am: ደግሞም አሥር የመታጠቢያ ሰኖች ሠራ፥ ለሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት የሚቀርበው ነገር ሁሉ ይታጠብባቸው ዘንድ አምስቱን በቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በግራ አኖራቸው፤ ኵሬው ግን ካህናት ይታጠቡበት ነበር።
text.en: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

text.am: አሥሩንም መቅረዞች እንደ ሥርዓታቸው ከወርቅ ሠርቶ አምስቱን በቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በግራ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ አኖራቸው።
text.en: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

text.am: አሥሩንም ገበታዎች ሠርቶ አምስቱን በቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በግራ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ አኖራቸው። አንድ መቶም የወርቅ ድስቶች ሠራ።
text.en: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.

text.am: ደግሞም የካህናቱን አደባባይ፥ ታላቁንም አደባባይ፥ የአደባባዩንም ደጆች ሠራ፥ ደጆቻቸውንም በናስ ለበጠ።
text.en: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

text.am: ኵሬውንም በቤቱ ቀኝ በአዜብ በኩል አኖረው።
text.en: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

text.am: ኪራምም ምንቸቶቹንና መጫሪያዎቹን ድስቶቹንም ሠራ። ኪራምም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራውን ሥራ ሁሉ ጨረሰ።
text.en: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;

text.am: ሁለቱን አዕማድ፥ ጽዋዎቹንም፥ በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ሁለት ጕልላቶች፥ በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን የጕልላቶች ሁለቱን ጽዋዎች የሚሸፍኑትን ሁለቱን መርበቦች ሠራ።
text.en: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;

text.am: በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ሁለቱን ጕልላቶች ይሸፍኑ ዘንድ፥ ለእያንዳንዱ መርበብ ሁለት ሁለት ተራ ሮማኖች፥ ለሁለቱ መርበቦች አራት መቶ ሮማኖች አደረገ።
text.en: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.

text.am: መቀመጫዎቹንና በመቀመጫዎቹ ላይ የሚቀመጡትን የመታጠቢያ ሰኖች፥
text.en: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;

text.am: አንዱንም ኵሬ፥ በበታቹም የሚሆኑትን አሥራ ሁለት በሬዎች ሠራ።
text.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

text.am: ምንቸቶቹንም መጫሪያዎቹንም ሜንጦዎቹንም ዕቃቸውንም ሁሉ ኪራም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ከለስላሳ ናስ ሠራ።
text.en: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.

text.am: ንጉሡም በዮርዳኖስ ሜዳ በሱኮትና በጽሬዳ መካከል ባለው በወፍራሙ መሬት ውስጥ አስፈሰሰው።
text.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም እነዚህን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ እጅግ አብዝቶ ሠራ፤ የናሱም ሚዛን አይቈጠርም ነበር።
text.en: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን ዕቃ ሁሉ የወርቁንም መሠዊያ፥ የገጹንም ኅብስት የነበረባቸውን ገበታዎች፥
text.en: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;

text.am: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ፊት እንደ ሥርዓታቸው ያበሩ ዘንድ መቅረዞችንና ቀንዲሎቻቸውን ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠራ።
text.en: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

text.am: አበባዎቹንና ቀንዲሎቹን መኮስተሪያዎቹንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠራ።
text.en: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;

text.am: ጕጦቹንም ድስቶቹንም ጭልፋዎቹንም ማንደጃዎቹንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠራ። የውስጠኛውም ቤት የቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ደጆች የቤተ መቅደሱም ደጆች የወርቅ ነበሩ።
text.en: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.

text.am: እንዲሁም ሰሎሞን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ተጨረሰ። አባቱም ዳዊት የቀደሰውን የብርና የወርቅ ዕቃ ሁሉ ሰሎሞን አምጥቶ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በነበረው ግምጃ ቤት አኖረው።
text.en: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ሰሎሞን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ከዳዊት ከተማ ከጽዮን ያወጡ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ሽማግሌዎችና የነገድ አለቆች ሁሉ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች አባቶች ቤቶች መሳፍንት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሰበሰበ።
text.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.

text.am: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሁሉ በሰባተኛው ወር በበዓሉ ጊዜ ጊዜ ወደ ንጉሡ ተከማቹ።
text.en: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.

text.am: የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ መጡ፥ ሌዋውያንም ታቦቱን አነሡ።
text.en: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

text.am: ታቦቱንም የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን በድኳኑም ውስጥ የነበረውን የተቀደሰውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አመጡ፤ እነዚህንም ሁሉ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ አመጡ።
text.en: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከእርሱም ጋር የተሰበሰቡ የእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ በታቦቱ ፊት ሆነው ከብዛት የተነሣ የማይቈጠሩትንና የማይመጠኑትን በጎችና በሬዎች ይሠዉ ነበር።
text.en: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

text.am: ካህናቱም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ወደ ቤቱ አምጥተው በቅድስት ቅዱሳን ውስጥ ከኪሩቤል ክንፍ በታች በነበረው በስፍራው አኖሩት።
text.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:

text.am: ኪሩቤልም በታቦቱ ስፍራ ላይ ክንፎቻቸውን ዘርግተው ነበር፥ ኪሩቤልም ታቦቱንና መሎጊያዎቹን በስተ ላዩ በኩል ይሸፍኑ ነበር።
text.en: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

text.am: መሎጊያዎቹም ረጃጅሞች ነበሩና በቅዱስተ ቅዱሳን ፊት ከመቅደሱ ውስጥ ጫፎቻቸው ይታዩ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ከውጪ አይታዩም ነበር፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ እዚያ አሉ።
text.en: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.

text.am: በታቦቱም ውስጥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር በወጡ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ባደረገ ጊዜ ሙሴ በኮሬብ ካስቀመጣቸው ከሁለቱ ጽላቶች በቀር ምንም አልነበረበትም።
text.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

text.am: በዚያም የነበሩት ካህናት ሁሉ ተቀድሰው ነበር፥ በሰሞናቸውም አልተከፈሉም ነበር፤
text.en: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:

text.am: መዘምራንም የነበሩት ሌዋውያን ሁሉ፥ አሳፍና ኤማን ኤዶታምም ልጆቻቸውም ወንድሞቻቸውም፥ ጥሩ በፍታ ለብሰው ጸናጽልና በገና መሰንቆም እየመቱ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ በመሥራቅ በኩል ቆመው ነበር፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር መቶ ሀያ ካህናት መለከት ይነፉ ነበር። ካህናቱም ከመቅደሱ በወጡ ጊዜ፥
text.en: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)

text.am: መለከቱንም የሚነፉ መዘምራኑም በአንድነት ሆነው እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑና እያከበሩ። እግዚአብሔር ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ እያሉ በአንድ ቃል ድምፃቸውን ወደ ላይ ከፍ አድገው በመለከትና በጸናጽል በዜማም ዕቃ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ባመሰገኑ ጊዜ፥ ደመናው የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞላው።
text.en: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the LORD;

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞልቶት ነበርና ካህናቱ ከደመናው የተነሣ መቆምና ማገልገል አልተቻላቸውም።
text.en: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም። እግዚአብሔር። በጨለማ ውስጥ እኖራለሁ ብሎአል፤
text.en: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

text.am: እኔ ግን ለዘላለም ትኖርበት ዘንድ ማደሪያ ቤትን ሠራሁልህ አለ።
text.en: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.

text.am: ንጉሡም ፊቱን ዘወር አድርጎ የእስራኤልን ጉባኤ ሁሉ መረቀ፤ የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ቆመው ነበር።
text.en: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

text.am: እርሱም አለ። ለአባቴ ለዳዊት በአፉ የተናገረ በእጁም የፈጸመ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ፤
text.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,

text.am: እርሱም። ሕዝቤን ከግብጽ ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ ስሜ የሚጠራበት ቤት በዚያ ይሠራልኝ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ማንኛውንም ከተማ አልመረጥሁም፤ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ ማንንም አልመረጥሁም፤
text.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:

text.am: ነገር ግን ስሜ በዚያ እንዲጠራባት ኢየሩሳሌምን መርጫለሁ፥ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ እንዲሆን ዳዊትን መርጫለሁ ብሎአልና።
text.en: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

text.am: አባቴም ዳዊት ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ በልቡ አስቦ ነበር።
text.en: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም አባቴን ዳዊትን። ለስሜ ቤት ትሠራ ዘንድ በልብህ አስበሃልና ይህን በልብህ መልካም አደረግህ።
text.en: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:

text.am: ነገር ግን ከወገብህ የሚወጣው ልጅህ እርሱ ለስሜ ቤትን ይሠራል እንጂ ቤት የምትሠራልኝ አንተ አይደለህም አለው።
text.en: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም የተናገረውን ቃል ፈጸመ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ተስፋ እንደ ሰጠ በአባቴ በዳዊት ፋንታ ተነሣሁ፥ በእስራኤልም ዙፋን ላይ ተቀመጥሁ፥ ለእስራኤልም አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ሠራሁ።
text.en: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

text.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ጋር ያደረገው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ያለበትን ታቦት በዚያው ውስጥ አኖርሁ።
text.en: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ርዝመቱ አምስት ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አምስት ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም ሦስት ክንድ የሆነ የናስ መደገፊያ ሠርቶ በአደባባዩ መካከል ተክሎት ነበር፥ በላዩም ቆመ፥ በእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ፊት በጕልበቱ ተንበርክኮ እጁን ወደ ሰማይ ዘረጋ፤ የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ እያዩ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ፊት ቆሞ እጆቹንም ዘርግቶ እንዲህ አለ።
text.en: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ርዝመቱ አምስት ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አምስት ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም ሦስት ክንድ የሆነ የናስ መደገፊያ ሠርቶ በአደባባዩ መካከል ተክሎት ነበር፥ በላዩም ቆመ፥ በእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ፊት በጕልበቱ ተንበርክኮ እጁን ወደ ሰማይ ዘረጋ፤ የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ እያዩ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ፊት ቆሞ እጆቹንም ዘርግቶ እንዲህ አለ።
text.en: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,

text.am: አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማይ ወይም በምድር አንተን የሚመስል አምላክ የለም፤ በፍጹም ልባቸው በፊትህ ለሚሄዱ ባሪያዎችህ ቃል ኪዳንንና ምሕረትን የምትጠብቅ፥
text.en: And said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:

text.am: ለባሪያህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የሰጠኸውን ተስፋ የጠበቀህ፤ በአፍህ ተናገርህ፥ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነው በእጅህ ፈጸምኸው።
text.en: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

text.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ። አንተ በፊቴ እንደ ሄድህ ልጆችህ በሕጌ ይሄዱ ዘንድ መንገዳቸውን ቢጠብቁ በእስራኤል ዙፋን የሚቀመጥ ሰው በፊቴ አታጣም ብለህ ተስፋ የሰጠኸውን ለባሪያህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት ጠብቅ።
text.en: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.

text.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ ለባሪያህ ለዳዊት የተናገረኸው ቃል ይጽና።
text.en: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.

text.am: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር ከሰው ጋር በምድር ላይ ይኖራልን? እነሆ፥ ሰማይ ከሰማያትም በላይ ያለ ሰማይ ይይዝህ ዘንድ አይችልም፤ ይልቁንስ እኔ የሠራሁት ቤት እንዴት ያንስ ይሆን?
text.en: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

text.am: ነገር ግን፥ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ወደ ባሪያህ ጸሎትና ልመና ተመልከት፥ ባሪያህም በፊትህ የሚጸልየውን ጸሎትና ጥሪውን ስማ።
text.en: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:

text.am: ባሪያህ ወደዚህ ስፍራ የሚጸልየውን ጸሎት ትሰማ ዘንድ። በዚያ ስሜ ይሆናል ወዳልኸው ስፍራ፥ ወደዚህ ቤት ዓይኖችህ ቀንና ሌሊት የተገለጡ ይሁኑ።
text.en: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.

text.am: ባሪያህና ሕዝብህ እስራኤል ወደዚህ ስፍራ የሚጸልዩትን ልመና ስማ፤ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ ሰምተህም ይቅር በል።
text.en: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.

text.am: ሰው ባልንጀራውን ቢበድል፥ በላዩም መሐላ ቢጫን፥ እርሱም መጥቶ በዚህ ቤት በመሠዊያህ ፊት ቢምል፥
text.en: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;

text.am: በሰማይ ስማ፥ አድርግም፥ በባሪያዎችህም ላይ ዳኛ ሁን፥ በበደለኛውም ላይ ፍረድ፥ መንገዱንም በራሱ ላይ መልስበት፤ ንጹሑንም አጽድቀው፥ እንደ ጽድቁም ክፈለው።
text.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

text.am: ሕዝብህም እስራኤል አንተን ስለ በደሉ በጠላት ፊት ድል ተመትተው ወደ አንተ ቢመለሱ፥ ስምህንም ቢያከብሩ፥ በዚህም ቤት በፊትህ ቢጸልዩና ቢለምኑህ፥ አንተ በሰማይ ስማ፥
text.en: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;

text.am: የሕዝብህንም የእስራኤልን ኃጢአት ይቅር በል፤ ለእነርሱም ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጥሃት ምድር መልሳቸው።
text.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.

text.am: አንተን ስለ በደሉ ሰማያት በተዘጉ ጊዜ ዝናብም ባልዘነበ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚህ ስፍራ ቢጸልዩ፥ ስምህንም ቢያከብሩ፥ ባስጨነቅሃቸውም ጊዜ ከኃጢአታቸው ቢመለሱ፥ አንተ በሰማይ ስማ፥
text.en: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;

text.am: የባሪያዎችህንና የሕዝብህን የእስራኤልን ኃጢአት ይቅር በል፥ የሚሄዱበትንም መልካም መንገድ አሳያቸው፤ ለሕዝብህም ርስት አድርገህ ለሰጠሃት ምድር ዝናብን ስጥ።
text.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.

text.am: በምድር ላይ ራብ ወይም ቸነፈር ወይም ዋግ ወይም አረማሞ ወይም አንበጣ ወይም ኩብኩባ ቢሆን፥ ጠላቶቻቸውም የአገሩን ከተሞች ከብበው ቢያስጨንቁአቸው፥ ማናቸውም መቅሠፍትና ደዌ ቢሆን፥
text.en: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:

text.am: ማንም ሰው ወይም ሕዝብህ እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ማናቸውም ሰው ሕመሙንና ኀዘኑን አውቆ ጸሎትና ልመና ቢያደርግ እጆቹንም ወደዚህ ቤት ቢዘረጋ፥
text.en: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:

text.am: ለአባቶቻችን በሰጠኸው ምድር ላይ በሚኖሩበት ዘመን ሁሉ ይፈሩህ ዘንድ በመንገዶችህም ይሄዱ ዘንድ፥ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፥ ይቅርም በል፤ አንተ ብቻ የሰውን ልጆች ልብ ታውቃለህና ልቡን ለምታውቀው ሰው ሁሉ እንደ መንገዱ ሁሉ መጠን ክፈለው።
text.en: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)

text.am: ለአባቶቻችን በሰጠኸው ምድር ላይ በሚኖሩበት ዘመን ሁሉ ይፈሩህ ዘንድ በመንገዶችህም ይሄዱ ዘንድ፥ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፥ ይቅርም በል፤ አንተ ብቻ የሰውን ልጆች ልብ ታውቃለህና ልቡን ለምታውቀው ሰው ሁሉ እንደ መንገዱ ሁሉ መጠን ክፈለው።
text.en: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

text.am: ከሕዝብህም ከእስራኤል ያልሆነ እንግዳ ስለ ታላቁ ስምህ ስለ ብርቱውም እጅህ ስለ ተዘረጋውም ክንድህ ከሩቅ አገር በመጣ ጊዜ፥ መጥቶም ወደዚህ ቤት በጸለየ ጊዜ፥
text.en: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;

text.am: አንተ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ስምህን ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ እንደ ሕዝብህም እንደ እስራኤል ይፈሩህ ዘንድ፥ በዚህም በሠራሁት ቤት ስምህ እንደ ተጠራ ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ እንግዳው የሚለምንህን ሁሉ አድርግ።
text.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.

text.am: ሕዝብህም ጠላቶቻቸውን ለመውጋት አንተ በምትልካቸው መንገድ ቢወጡ፥ አንተም ወደ መረጥሃት ወደዚህች ከተማ እኔም ለስምህ ወደ ሠራሁት ቤት ለአንተ ቢጸልዩ፥
text.en: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;

text.am: ጸሎታቸውንና ልመናቸውን በሰማይ ስማ፥ ፍርድንም አድርግላቸው።
text.en: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

text.am: የማይበድል ሰው የለምና አንተን ቢበድሉ፥ ተቈጥተህም ለጠላት አሳልፈህ ብትሰጣቸው፥ ሩቅም ወይም ቅርብ ወደ ሆነ አገር ቢማርኩአቸው፥
text.en: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;

text.am: በተማረኩበትም አገር ሆነው በልባቸው ንስሐ ቢገቡ፥ በምርኮአቸውም አገር ሳሉ ተመልሰው። ኃጢአት ሠርተናል፥ በድለንማል፥ ክፉም አድርገናል ብለው ቢለምኑህ፥
text.en: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;

text.am: በተማረኩበትም በምርኮአቸው አገር ሳሉ በፍጹም ልባቸውና በፍጹም ነፍሳቸው ወደ አንተ ቢመለሱ፥ ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጠሃት ወደ ምድራቸው ወደ መረጥሃትም ከተማ ለስምህም ወደ ሠራሁት ቤት ቢጸልዩ፥
text.en: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:

text.am: ጸሎታቸውንና ልመናቸውን በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፥ ፍርድንም አድርግላቸው፤ አንተንም የበደሉህን ሕዝብህን ይቅር በል።
text.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.

text.am: አሁንም፥ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ በዚህ ስፍራ ወደሚሆነው ጸሎት ዓይኖችህ የተገለጡ፥ ጆሮችህም የሚያደምጡ እንዲሆኑ እለምንሃለሁ።
text.en: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

text.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከኃይልህ ታቦት ጋር ወደ ዕረፍትህ ተነሣ፤ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ካህናትህ ደኅንነትን ይልበሱ፤ ቅዱሳንህም በደስታ ደስ ይበላቸው።
text.en: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

text.am: አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ የቀባኸውን ሰው ፊት አትመልስ ለባሪያም ለዳዊት ያደረግህለትን ምሕረት አስብ።
text.en: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ጸሎቱን በፈጸመ ጊዜ እሳት ከሰማይ ወርዶ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ሌላ መሥዋዕቱን በላ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ቤቱን ሞላ።
text.en: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞልቶት ነበርና ካህናቱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት መግባት አልቻሉም።
text.en: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD'S house.

text.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ እሳቱ ሲወርድ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር በቤቱ ላይ ሲሆን ያዩ ነበር፤ በወለሉም ላይ በግምባራቸው ወደ ምድር ተደፍተው ሰገዱ። እርሱ መልካም ነውና፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና ብለውም እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ።
text.en: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ነበር።
text.en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ በሬዎችና መቶ ሀያ ሺህ በጎች ሠዋ። እንዲሁ ንጉሡና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ቀደሱ።
text.en: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

text.am: ካህናቱም በየሥርዓታቸው፥ ሌዋውያኑም ደግሞ። ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ የሚለውን የዳዊትን መዝሙር እየዘመሩ፥ ንጉሡ ዳዊት እግዚአብሔርን ለማመስገን የሠራውን የእግዚአብሔርን የዜማ ዕቃ ይዘው ቆመው ነበር፤ ካህናቱም በፊታቸው መለከት ይነፉ ነበር፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ቆመው ነበር።
text.en: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

text.am: ሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ፊት የነበረውን የአደባባዩን ውስጥ ቀደሰ፤ ሰሎሞንም የሠራው የናስ መሠዊያ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን ስቡንም መያዝ አልቻለምና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ስብ በዚያ አቀረበ።
text.en: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ከእርሱም ጋር እጅግ ታላቅ ጉባኤ የሆኑ፥ ከሐማት መግቢያ ጀምሮ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ ድረስ ያሉ እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ሰባት ቀን በዓል አደረጉ።
text.en: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.

text.am: ሰባት ቀንም መሠዊያውን ቀድሰው፥ ሰባት ቀንም በዓል አድርገው ነበርና በስምንተኛው ቀን የተቀደሰውን ጉባኤ አደረጉ።
text.en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

text.am: በሰባተኛውም ወር በሃያ ሦስተኛውም ቀን ሕዝቡን ወደ ድንኳናቸው አሰናበተ፤ እግዚአብሔር ለዳዊትና ለሰሎሞን ለሕዝቡም ለእስራኤል ስላደረገው ቸርነት ደስ ብሎአቸው ሐሴትን እያደረጉ ሄዱ።
text.en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት ጨረሰ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በራሱ ቤት ይሠራው ዘንድ በልቡ ያሰበውን ሁሉ አከናወነ።
text.en: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለሰሎሞን በሌሊት ተገልጦ እንዲህ አለው። ጸሎትህን ሰምቻለሁ፥ ይህንም ስፍራ ለራሴ ለመሥዋዕት ቤት መርጫለሁ።
text.en: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.

text.am: ዝናብ እንዳይወርድ ሰማያቱን ብዘጋ፥ ወይም ምድሪቱን ይበላ ዘንድ አንበጣን ባዝዘው፥ ወይም በሕዝብ ላይ ቸነፈር ብሰድድ፥
text.en: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

text.am: በስሜ የተጠሩት ሕዝቤ ሰውነታቸውን አዋርደው ቢጸልዩ፥ ፊቴንም ቢፈግሉ፥ ከክፉ መንገዳቸውም ቢመለሱ፥ በሰማይ ሆኜ እሰማለሁ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር እላለሁ፥ ምድራቸውንም እፈውሳለሁ።
text.en: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

text.am: አሁንም በዚህ ስፍራ ለሚጸለይ ጸሎት ዓይኖቼ ይገለጣሉ፥ ጆሮቼም ያደምጣሉ።
text.en: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

text.am: አሁንም ስሜ ለዘላለም በዚያ ይኖር ዘንድ ይህን ቤት መርጫለሁ ቀድሻለሁም፤ ዓይኖቼና ልቤም ዘወትር በዚያ ይሆናሉ።
text.en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

text.am: አንተም ደግሞ አባትህ ዳዊት እንደ ሄደ በፊቴ ብትሄድ፥ እንዳዘዝሁህም ሁሉ ብታደርግ፥ ሥርዓቴንና ፍርዴንም ብትጠብቅ፥
text.en: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;

text.am: ከአባትህ ከዳዊት ጋር። በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ፥ የሚሆን ከዘርህ አይታጣም ብዬ ቃል ኪዳን እንዳደረግሁ የመንግሥትህን ዙፋን አጸናለሁ።
text.en: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.

text.am: እናንተ ግን እኔን ከመከተል ብትመለሱ፥ የሰጠኋችሁንም ሥርዓቴንና ትእዛዜን ብትተዉ፥ ሄዳችሁም ሌሎችን አማልክት ብታመልኩ ብትሰግዱላቸውም፥
text.en: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

text.am: ለአባቶቻችሁ ከሰጠኋቸው ምድር እነቅላችኋለሁ፤ ለስሜም የቀደስሁትን ይህን ቤት ከፊቴ እጥለዋለሁ፥ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ መካከል ምሳሌና ተረት አደርገዋለሁ።
text.en: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.

text.am: ከፍ ከፍ ብሎ የነበረውንም ይህን ቤት እያዩ በዚያ የሚያልፉ ሰዎች ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር በዚህ አገርና በዚህ ቤት ስለ ምን እንዲህ አደረገ? ብለው ይደነቃሉ።
text.en: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?

text.am: መልሰውም። ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣቸውን የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው ሌሎችን አማልክት ስለ ተከተሉ፥ ስለ ሰገዱላቸውም፥ ስለ አመለኩአቸውም፥ ስለዚህ ይህን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አመጣባቸው ይላሉ።
text.en: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.

text.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሰሎሞን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የራሱን ቤት የሠራበት ሀያ ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥
text.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,

text.am: ኪራም ለሰሎሞን የሰጠውን ከተሞች ሰሎሞን ሠራቸው፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች አኖረባቸው።
text.en: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ወደ ሐማትሱባ ሄደ አሸነፋትም።
text.en: And Solomon went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.

text.am: በምድረ በዳም ያለውን ተድሞርን፥ በሐማትም የሠራቸውን የዕቃ ቤቱን ከተሞች ሁሉ ሠራ።
text.en: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.

text.am: ደግሞም ቅጥርና መዝጊያ መወርወሪያም የነበራቸውን የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች ላይኛውን ቤትሖሮን ታችኛውንም ቤትሖሮን ሠራ።
text.en: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

text.am: ባዕላትንም፥ ለሰሎሞንም የነበሩትን የዕቃ ቤት ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ የሰረገላውንም ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ የፈረሰኞችንም ከተሞች፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሊባኖስም በመንግሥቱም ምድር ሁሉ ሰሎሞን ይሠራ ዘንድ የወደደውን ሁሉ ሠራ።
text.en: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.

text.am: ከኬጢያውያንም ከአሞራውያንም ከፌርዜያውያንም ከኤዊያውያንም ከኢያቡሳውያንም የቀሩትን ከእስራኤል ወገን ያልሆኑትን ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥
text.en: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,

text.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ያላጠፉአቸውን፥ በኋላቸው በምድር ላይ የቀሩትን ልጆቻቸውን ሰሎሞን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ገባሮች አድርጎ መለመላቸው።
text.en: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ለሥራው ከእስራኤል ልጆች ማንንም ባሪያ አላደረገም፤ እነርሱ ግን ሰልፈኞች፥ የሹማምቶችም አለቆች፥ የሰረገሎችና የፈረሰኞች ባልደራሶች ነበሩ።
text.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

text.am: እነዚህም በሕዝቡ ላይ ሠልጥነው የነበሩ የንጉሡ የሰሎሞን ዓይነተኞች አለቆች ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።
text.en: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም። የእግዚአብሔር ታቦት የገባበት ስፍራ ቅዱስ ነውና ሚስቴ በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በዳዊት ቤት አትቀመጥም ሲል የፈርዖንን ልጅ ከዳዊት ከተማ ወደ ሠራላት ቤት አወጣት።
text.en: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ሰሎሞን በወለሉ ፊት በሠራው በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አቀረበ።
text.en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built before the porch,

text.am: ሙሴም እንዳዘዘ እንደ ሥርዓታቸው በየቀኑ ሁሉ፥ በየሰንበታቱም፥ በየመባቻዎቹም፥ በየተወሰኑትም በዓላት፥ በየዓመቱ ሦስት ጊዜ በየቂጣው በዓልና በየሰባቱ ሱባዔ በዓል በየዳሱም በዓል ቍርባን ያቀርቡ ነበር።
text.en: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ዳዊት እንዲህ አዝዞ ነበርና ካህናቱን እንደ አባቱ እንደ ዳዊት ሥርዓት በየአገልግሎታቸው ሰሞን ከፈላቸው፤ ሌዋውያንም እንደ ሥርዓታቸው ያመሰግኑ ዘንድ፥ በካህናቱም ፊት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ በየሰሞናቸው ከፈላቸው፤ በረኞቹንም ደግሞ በየበሩ ሁሉ በየሰሞናቸው ከፈላቸው።
text.en: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.

text.am: እነርሱም ንጉሡ ስለ ነገሩ ሁሉና ስለ መዝገቡ ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን ያዘዘውን ነገር ሁሉ አልተላለፉም።
text.en: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት መሠረት ከተጣለ ጀምሮ እስከ ተጨረሰ ድረስ የሰሎሞን ሥራ ሁሉ የተዘጋጀ ነበረ። የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ተፈጸመ።
text.en: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም የዚያን ጊዜ በኤዶምያስ ምድር በባሕር ዳር ወዳሉ ወደ ዔጽዮንጋብርና ወደ ኤሎት ሄደ።
text.en: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.

text.am: ኪራምም መርከቦችንና የባሕርን ነገር የሚያውቁትን መርከበኞች በባሪያዎቹ እጅ ሰደደለት፤ እነርሱም ከሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች ጋር ወደ ኦፊር መጡ፥ ከዚያም አራት መቶ አምሳ መክሊት ወርቅ ወስደው ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሰሎሞን አመጡ።
text.en: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

text.am: የሳባም ንግሥት የሰሎሞንን ዝና በሰማች ጊዜ በግመሎች ላይ ሽቱና ብዙ ወርቅ የከበረም ዕንቍ አስጭና ከታላቅ ጓዝ ጋር ሰሎሞንን በኢየሩሳሌም በእንቆቅልሽ ትፈትነው ዘንድ መጣች፤ ወደ ሰሎሞንም በገባች ጊዜ በልብዋ ያለውን ሁሉ አጫወተችው።
text.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም የጠየቀችውን ሁሉ ፈታላት፤ ሰሎሞንም ያልፈታው ስውር ነገር አልነበረም።
text.en: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

text.am: የሳባም ንግሥት የሰሎሞንን ጥበብ፥ ሠርቶትም የነበረውን ቤት፥ የማዕዱንም መብል፥
text.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

text.am: የብላቴኖቹንም አቀማመጥ፥ የሎሌዎቹንም አሠራር አለባበሳቸውንም፥ ጠጅ አሳላፊዎቹንም አለባበሳቸውንም በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የሚያሳርገውን መሥዋዕት ባየች ጊዜ መንፈስ አልቀረላትም።
text.en: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.

text.am: ንጉሡንም አለችው። ስለ ነገርህና ስለ ጥበብህ በአገሬ ሳለሁ የሰማሁት ዝና እውነት ነው።
text.en: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:

text.am: እኔ ግን መጥቼ በዓይኔ እስካየሁ ድረስ የነገሩኝን አላመንሁም፤ እነሆ፥ የጥበብህን ታላቅነት እኵሌታ አልነገሩኝም፤ ከሰማሁት ዝና ትበልጣለህ።
text.en: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.

text.am: በፊትህ ሁልጊዜ የሚቆሙ ጥበብህንም የሚሰሙ ሰዎችህና እነዚህ ባሪያዎችህ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።
text.en: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

text.am: በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ንጉሥ እንድትሆን በዙፋኑ ላይ ያስቀምጥህ ዘንድ የወደደህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ብሩክ ይሁን፤ አምላክህ እስራኤልን ለዘላለም ያጸናቸው ዘንድ ወድዶአቸዋልና ስለዚህ ፍርድና ጽድቅ ታደርግ ዘንድ በላያቸው አነገሠህ።
text.en: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

text.am: ለንጉሡም መቶ ሀያ መክሊት ወርቅ፥ እጅግም ብዙ ሽቱ የከበረም ዕንቍ ሰጠችው፤ የሳባም ንግሥት ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን እንደ ሰጠችው ያለ ሽቱ ከቶ አልነበረም።
text.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

text.am: ከኦፊርም ወርቅ ያመጡ የኪራም ባሪያዎችና የሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች የሰንደል እንጨትና የከበረ ዕንቍ ደግሞ አመጡ።
text.en: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

text.am: ንጉሡም ከሰንደሉ እንጨት ለእግዚአብሔር ቤትና ለንጉሡ ቤት ደርብ፥ ለመዘምራኑም መሰንቆና በገና አደረገ፤ እንደዚህም ያለ በይሁዳ ምድር ከቶ አልታየም ነበር።
text.en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

text.am: የሳባም ንግሥት ወደ ንጉሡ ካመጣችው የሚበልጥ፥ ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን የወደደችውን ሁሉ ከእርሱም የለመነችውን ሁሉ ሰጣት፤ እርስዋም ተመልሳ ከባሪያዎችዋ ጋር ወደ ምድርዋ ሄደች።
text.en: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

text.am: ነጋድራሶችና ነጋዴዎች ካመጡለት ሌላ በየዓመቱ ወደ ሰሎሞን የሚመጣ የወርቅ ሚዛን ስድስት መቶ ስድሳ ስድስት መክሊት ወርቅ ነበረ።
text.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

text.am: የዓረብም ነገሥታት ሁሉ የምድሩም ሹማምት ወርቅና ብር ወደ ሰሎሞን ያመጡ ነበር።
text.en: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን በጥፍጥፍ ወርቅ ሁለት መቶ አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻ አሠራ፤ በአንዱም አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻ ውስጥ የገባው ጥፍጥፍ ወርቅ ስድስት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ።
text.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

text.am: ከጥፍጥም ወርቅ ሦስት መቶ ጋሻ አሠራ፤ በአንዱም ጋሻ የገባው ወርቅ ሦስት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ፤ ንጉሡም የሊባኖስ ዱር በተባለው ቤት ውስጥ አኖራቸው።
text.en: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

text.am: ንጉሡም ደግሞ ከዘሆን ጥርስ ታላቅ ዙፋን አሠራ፥ በጥሩ ወርቅም ለበጠው።
text.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

text.am: ከዙፋኑም ጋር ተጋጥመው ወደ ዙፋኑም የሚያስሄዱ ስድስት እርከኖች ነበሩ፤ የወርቅ ብርኩማም ነበረ፤ በዚህና በዚያም በመቀመጫው፤ አጠገብ ሁለት የክንድ መደገፊያዎች ነበሩበት፥ በመደገፊያዎችም አጠገብ ሁለት አንበሶች ቆመው ነበር።
text.en: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

text.am: በስድስቱም እርከኖች ላይ በዚህና በዚያ አሥራ ሁለት አንበሶች ቆመው ነበር፤ በመንግሥታት ሁሉ እንዲህ ያለ ሥራ አልተሠራም።
text.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን የሚጠጣበት ዕቃ ሁሉ የወርቅ ነበረ፥ የሊባኖስ ዱር በተባለውም ቤቱ የነበረው ዕቃ ሁሉ ጥሩ ወርቅ ነበረ፤ በሰሎሞን ዘመን ብር ከቶ አይቈጠርም ነበር።
text.en: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

text.am: ለንጉሡም ከኪራም ባሪያዎች ጋር ወደ ተርሴስ የሚሄዱ መርከቦች ነበሩት፤ በሦስት በሦስት ዓመትም አንድ ጊዜ የተርሴስ መርከቦች ወርቅና ብር የዘሆንም ጥርስ ዝንጀሮና ዝጕርጕር ወፍም ይዘው ይመጡ ነበር።
text.en: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ በባለጠግነትና በጥበብ በለጠ።
text.en: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

text.am: የምድርም ነገሥታት ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር በልቡ ያኖረውን ጥበቡን ይሰሙ ዘንድ የሰሎሞንን ፊት ሊያዩ ይመኙ ነበር።
text.en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.

text.am: እያንዳንዱም ገጸ በረከቱን፥ የወርቅንና የብርን ዕቃ፥ ልብስንና የጦር መሣሪያን፥ ሽቱውንም፥ ፈረሶችንና በቅሎችን እየያዘ በየዓመቱ ያመጣ ነበር።
text.en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ለፈረሶችና ለሰረገሎች አራት ሺህ ጋጥ፥ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህም ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት፥ በሰረገሎችም ከተሞች፥ ከንጉሡም ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራቸው።
text.en: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

text.am: ከኤፍራጥስም ወንዝ ጀምሮ እስከ ፍልስጥኤም ምድርና እስከ ግብጽ ዳርቻ ድረስ ባሉ ነገሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ነገሠ።
text.en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

text.am: ንጉሡም ብሩን በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ድንጋይ እንዲበዛ አደረገው፤ የዝግባውንም እንጨት ብዛት በቈላ እንደሚበቅል ሾላ አደረገው።
text.en: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.

text.am: ለሰሎሞንም ፈረሶች ከግብጽና ከየአገሩ ሁሉ ያመጡለት ነበር።
text.en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

text.am: የቀረውም ፊተኛውና ኋለኛው የሰሎሞን ነገር በነቢዩ በናታን ታሪክ፥ በሴሎናዊውም በኦሒያ ትንቢት፥ ስለ ናባጥም ልጅ ስለ ኢዮርብዓም ባየው በባለ ራእዩ በአዶ ራእይ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?
text.en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

text.am: ሰሎሞንም በኢየሩሳሌም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ አርባ ዓመት ነገሠ።
text.en: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

text.am: ሰሎሞንም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ከተማ ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ሮብዓም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
text.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

text.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ያነግሡት ዘንድ ወደ ሴኬም መጥተው ነበርና ሮብዓም ወደ ሴኬም ሄደ።
text.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.

text.am: የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓምም ከንጉሡ ከሰሎሞን ፊት ሸሽቶ በግብጽ ይኖር ነበርና ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ኢዮርብዓም ከግብጽ ተመለሰ።
text.en: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

text.am: ልከውም ጠሩት፤ ኢዮርብዓምና እስራኤልም ሁሉ መጥተው ሮብዓምን።
text.en: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,

text.am: አባትህ ቀንበር አክብዶብን ነበር፤ አሁንም አንተ ጽኑውን የአባትህን አገዛዝ፥ በላያችንም የጫነውን የከበደውን ቀንበር አቅልልልን፥ እኛም እንገዛልሃለን ብለው ተናገሩት።
text.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

text.am: እርሱም። ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ አላቸው። ሕዝቡም ሄዱ።
text.en: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም። ለዚህ ሕዝብ እመልስለት ዘንድ የምትመክሩኝ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ አባቱ ሰሎሞን በሕይወት ሳለ በፊቱ ይቆሙ ከነበሩት ሽማግሌዎች ጋር ተማከረ።
text.en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?

text.am: እነርሱም። ለዚህ ሕዝብ ቸርነት ብታደርግላቸው፥ ደስም ብታሰኛቸው፥ በገርነትም ብትናገራቸው፥ ለዘላለም ባሪያዎች ይሆኑልሃል ብለው ተናገሩት።
text.en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

text.am: እርሱ ግን ሽማግሌዎች የመከሩትን ነገር ትቶ ከእርሱ ጋር ካደጉትና በፊቱ ይቆሙ ከነበሩት ብላቴኖች ጋር ተማከረ።
text.en: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

text.am: እርሱም። አባትህ የጫነብንን ቀንበር አቅልልልን ለሚሉኝ ሕዝብ እመልስላቸው ዘንድ የምትመክሩኝ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው።
text.en: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?

text.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ያደጉት ብላቴኖች። አባትህ ቀንበር አክብዶብን ነበር፥ አንተ ግን አቅልልልን ለሚሉህ ሕዝብ። ታናሽቱ ጣቴ ከአባቴ ወገብ ትወፍራለች፤
text.en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

text.am: አሁንም አባቴ ከባድ ቀንበር ጭኖባችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን በቀንበራችሁ ላይ እጨምራለሁ፤ አባቴ በአለንጋ ገርፎአችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን በጊንጥ እገርፋችኋለሁ በላቸው ብለው ተናገሩት።
text.en: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

text.am: ንጉሡም። በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ ብሎ እንደ ተናገረ ኢዮርብዓምና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ ሮብዓም መጡ።
text.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

text.am: ንጉሡም ጽኑ ምላሽ መለሰላቸው፤ ንጉሡም ሮብዓም የሽማግሌዎቹን ምክር ትቶ።
text.en: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

text.am: አባቴ ቀንበር አክብዶባችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን እጨምርበታለሁ፤ አባቴ በአለንጋ ገርፎአችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን በጊንጥ እገርፋችኋለሁ ብሎ እንደ ብላቴኖቹ ምክር ተናገራቸው።
text.en: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሴሎናዊው በአሒያ አድርጎ ለናባጥ ልጅ ለኢዮርብዓም የተናገረውን ቃል እንዲያጸና ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ተወስኖ ነበርና ንጉሡ ሕዝቡን አልሰማም።
text.en: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

text.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ንጉሡ እንዳልሰማቸው ባዩ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ። በዳዊት ዘንድ ምን ክፍል አለን? በእሴይም ልጅ ዘንድ ርስት የለንም፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ወደ እየድንኳኖቻችሁ ተመለሱ፤ ዳዊት ሆይ፥ አሁን ቤትህን ተመልከት ብለው ለንጉሡ መለሱለት። እስራኤልም ሁሉ ወደ እየድንኳኖቻቸው ሄዱ።
text.en: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.

text.am: በይሁዳ ከተሞች በተቀመጡት በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ግን ሮብዓም ነገሠባቸው።
text.en: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም አስገባሪውን አዶራምን ሰደደ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በድንጋይ ወገሩት፥ ሞተም፤ ንጉሡም ሮብዓም ፈጥኖ ወደ ሰረገላው ወጣ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሸሸ።
text.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

text.am: እስራኤልም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከዳዊት ቤት ሸፈተ።
text.en: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

text.am: ሮብዓምም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በመጣ ጊዜ እስራኤልን ወግተው መንግሥቱን ወደ ሮብዓም ይመልሱ ዘንድ ከይሁዳና ከብንያም ቤት የተመረጡትን አንድ መቶ ሰማንያ ሺህ ሰልፈኞች ሰዎች ሰበሰበ።
text.en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ሸማያ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።
text.en: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

text.am: ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሰሎሞን ልጅ ለሮብዓም፥ በይሁዳና በብንያምም ላሉት ለእስራኤል ሁሉ።
text.en: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

text.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ነገር ከእኔ ዘንድ ነውና አትውጡ፥ ወንድሞቻችሁንም አትውጉ፤ እያንዳንዱም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለስ ብለህ ንገራቸው። የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ሰሙ፥ በኢዮርብዓምም ላይ ከመሄድ ተመለሱ።
text.en: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

text.am: ሮብዓምም በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጠ፥ በይሁዳም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች ሠራ።
text.en: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

text.am: በይሁዳና በብንያም ያሉትንም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች፥ ቤተ ልሔም፥ ኤጣምን፥ ቴቁሔን፥
text.en: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

text.am: ቤትጹርን፥ ሦኮን፥ ዓዶላምን፥ ጌትን፥ መሪሳን፥
text.en: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

text.am: ቤትጹርን፥ ሦኮን፥ ዓዶላምን፥ ጌትን፥ መሪሳን፥
text.en: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

text.am: ዚፍን፥ አዶራይምን፥ ለኪሶን፥ ዓዜቃን፥
text.en: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

text.am: ጾርዓን፥ ኤሎንን፥ ኬብሮንን፥ ሠራ።
text.en: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

text.am: ምሽጎቹንም አጠነከረ፥ አለቆችንም አኖረባቸው፥ ምግቡንም ዘይቱንም የወይን ጠጁንም አከማቸባቸው።
text.en: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

text.am: በከተሞቹ ሁሉ ጋሻና ጦርን አኖረ። ከተሞቹንም እጅግ አጠነከራቸው፤ ይሁዳና ብንያምም የእርሱ ወገን ነበሩ።
text.en: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

text.am: በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ዘንድ የነበሩ ካህናትና ሌዋውያን ከየአገራቸው ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ መጡ።
text.en: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ካህናት እንዳይሆኑ ኢዮርብዓምና ልጆቹ አስለቅቀዋቸው ነበርና ሌዋውያን መሰመሪያቸውንና ቦታቸውን ትተው ወደ ይሁዳና ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።
text.en: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the LORD:

text.am: እርሱ ግን ለኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ለአጋንንቱም ለሠራቸውም እምቦሶች ካህናትን አቆመ።
text.en: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

text.am: ደግሞም ለአባቶቻቸው አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ይሠዉ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ለመፈለግ ልባቸውን የሰጡ ሁሉ እነርሱን ተከትለው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።
text.en: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.

text.am: ሦስት ዓመት በዳዊትና በሰሎሞን መንገድ ይሄዱ ነበርና ሦስት ዓመት የይሁዳን መንግሥት አበረቱ፥ የሰሎሞንንም ልጅ ሮብዓምን አጸኑ።
text.en: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

text.am: ሮብዓምም መሐላትን አገባ፤ አባትዋ የዳዊት ልጅ ኢያሪሙት ነበረ፤ እናትዋም የእሴይ ልጅ የኤልያብ ልጅ አቢካኢል ነበረች።
text.en: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

text.am: እርስዋም የዑስን፥ ሰማራያን፥ ዘሃምን ወንዶች ልጆች ወለደችለት።
text.en: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

text.am: ከእርስዋም በኋላ የአቤሴሎምን ልጅ መዓካን አገባ፤ እርስዋም አብያን፥ ዓታይን፥ ዚዛን፥ ሰሎሚትን ወለደችለት።
text.en: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

text.am: ሮብዓምም ከሚስቶቹና ከቁባቶቹ ሁሉ ይልቅ የአቤሴሎምን ልጅ መዓካን ወደደ፤ አሥራ ስምንትም ሚስቶችና ስድሳ ቁባቶች ነበሩት፥ ሀያ ስምንት ወንዶችና ስድሳ ሴቶች ልጆች ወለደ።
text.en: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

text.am: ሮብዓምም ንጉሥ ያደርገው ዘንድ አስቦአልና የመዓካን ልጅ አብያን በወንድሞቹ ላይ አለቃ አድርጎ ሾመው።
text.en: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.

text.am: ተጠበበም፥ ልጆቹንም ሁሉ በይሁዳና በብንያም አገር ሁሉ በምሽጉ ከተሞች ሁሉ ከፋፈላቸው፤ ብዙም ምግብ ሰጣቸው፤ ብዙም ሚስቶች ፈለገላቸው።
text.en: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.

text.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የሮብዓም መንግሥት በጸናች ጊዜ፥ እርሱም በበረታ ጊዜ፥ እርሱና እስራኤል ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ተዉ።
text.en: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርን በድለዋልና ሮብዓም በነገሠ በአምስተኛው ዓመት የግብጽ ንጉሥ ሺሻቅ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ሰረገሎችና ስድሳ ሺህ ፈረሰኞች ይዞ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።
text.en: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,

text.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ከግብጽ ለመጣው ሕዝብ ቍጥር አልነበረውም፤ እነርሱም የልብያ ሰዎች፥ ሱካውያን፥ የኢትዮጵያ ሰዎችም ነበሩ።
text.en: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

text.am: ለይሁዳም የነበሩትን ምሽጎች ከተሞች ወሰደ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጣ።
text.en: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

text.am: ነበዩም ሸማያ ወደ ሮብዓምና ከሺሻቅ ሸሽተው በኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ተሰበሰቡባት ወደ ይሁዳ መሳፍንት መጥቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እናንተ ተዋችሁኝ፤ ስለዚህ እኔ ደግሞ በሺሻቅ እጅ ተውኋችሁ።
text.en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

text.am: የእስራኤልም መሳፍንትና ንጉሡ። እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው ብለው ሰውነታቸውን አዋረዱ።
text.en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰውነታቸውን እንዳዋረዱ ባየ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል። ሰውነታቸውን አዋርደዋል፤ አላጠፋቸውም፤ ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ አድናቸዋለሁ፥ ቍጣዬም በሺሻቅ እጅ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አይፈስስም፤
text.en: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

text.am: ነገር ግን ለእኔ መገዛትንና ለምድር ነገሥታት መገዛትን ያውቁ ዘንድ ይገዙለታል ሲል ወደ ሸማያ መጣ።
text.en: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

text.am: የግብጽ ንጉሥ ሺሻቅም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት መዛግብትና የንጉሡን ቤት መዛግብት ወሰደ፤ ሁሉንም ወሰደ፤ ደግሞም ሰሎሞን የሠራቸውን የወርቁን ጋሻዎች ወሰደ።
text.en: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም በእነርሱ ፋንታ የናስ ጋሻዎችን ሠራ፥ የንጉሡንም ቤት ደጅ በሚጠብቁ በዘበኞች አለቃ እጅ አኖራቸው።
text.en: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.

text.am: ንጉሡም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት በገባ ቍጥር ዘበኞች መጥተው ይሸከሙአቸው ነበር፥ መልሰውም በዘበኞች ቤት ውስጥ ያኖሩአቸው ነበር።
text.en: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

text.am: ሰውነቱንም ባዋረደ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ፈጽሞ እንዳያጠፋው ከእርሱ ዘንድ ተመለሰ፤ በይሁዳም ደግሞ መልካም ነገር ተገኘ።
text.en: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም በኢየሩሳሌም በረታ ንጉሥም ሆነ፤ ሮብዓምም በነገሠ ጊዜ የአርባ አንድ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ስሙን ያኖርባት ዘንድ ከእስራኤል አገር ሁሉ በመረጣት ከተማ በኢየሩሳሌም አሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የአሞን ሴት ናዕማ ነበረች።
text.en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርንም ይሻ ዘንድ ልቡን አላዘጋጀም ነበርና ክፉ ነገር አደረገ።
text.en: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD.

text.am: የሮብዓምም የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው ነገር በነቢዩ ሸማያና በባለ ራእዩ በአዶ የትውልድ ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን? በሮብዓምና በኢዮርብዓም መካከልም በዘመናቸው ሁሉ ሰልፍ ነበረ።
text.en: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

text.am: ሮብዓምም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም አብያ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
text.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

text.am: ንጉሡም ኢዮርብዓም በነገሠ በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት አብያ በይሁዳ ላይ ንጉሥ ሆነ።
text.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

text.am: ሦስት ዓመት በኢየሩሳሌም ነገሠ፤ የእናቱም ስም ሚካያ ነበረ፥ የገብዓ ሰው የኡርኤል ልጅ ነበረች።
text.en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

text.am: በአብያና በኢዮርብዓም መካከልም ሰልፍ ነበረ። አብያም የተመረጡትን አራት መቶ ሺህ ኃያላን ሰልፈኞች ይዞ ወደ ሰልፍ ወጣ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም የተመረጡትን ስምንት መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ይዞ በእርሱ ላይ ተሰለፈ።
text.en: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.

text.am: አብያም በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር ባለው በጽማራይም ተራራ ላይ ቆሞ እንዲህ አለ። ኢዮርብዓምና እስራኤል ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤
text.en: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;

text.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ መንግሥትን ለዳዊትና ለልጆቹ በጨው ቃል ኪዳን ለዘላለም እንደ ሰጠ በውኑ አታውቁምን?
text.en: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

text.am: የዳዊት ልጅ የሰሎሞን ባሪያ የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም ግን ተነሥቶ በጌታው ላይ ዐመፀ።
text.en: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.

text.am: ክፉዎች ሰዎችና ምናምንቴዎችም ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ፤ ሮብዓም ሕፃንና ለጋ በነበረበት ጊዜ፥ ሊቋቋማቸውም ባልቻለበት ጊዜ፥ በሰሎሞን ልጅ በሮብዓም ላይ በረቱበት።
text.en: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

text.am: አሁንም በዳዊት ልጆች እጅ የሚሆነውን የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ልትቋቋሙ ታስባላችሁ። እናንተም እጅግ ታላቅ ሕዝብ ናችሁ፥ ኢዮርብዓምም አማልክት አድርጎ የሠራላችሁ የወርቅ እምቦሶች ከእናንተ ጋር ናቸው።
text.en: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

text.am: የአሮንን ልጆች የእግዚአብሔርን ካህናትና ሌዋውያን አላሳደዳችሁምን? እንደ ሌሎችም አሕዛብ ልማድ ካህናትን አላደረጋችሁምን? አንድ ወይፈንና ሰባት አውራ በጎች ይዞ ይቀድስ ዘንድ የሚመጣ ሁሉ አማልክት ላልሆኑት ለእነዚያ ካህን ይሆናል።
text.en: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.

text.am: ለእኛ ግን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ አልተውነውም፤ የእግዚአብሔርም አገልጋዮች የአሮን ልጆች ካህናቱ ሌዋውያኑም በሥራቸው ከእኛ ጋር ናቸው።
text.en: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:

text.am: በየጥዋቱና በየማታውም ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ጣፋጩን ዕጣን ያሳርጋሉ፤ የገጹንም ኅብስት በንጹህ ገበታ ላይ፥ የወርቁን መቅረዝና ቀንዲሎቹንም ማታ ማታ እንዲያበሩ ያዘጋጃሉ፤ እኛም የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ እንጠብቃለን፥ እናንተ ግን ትታችሁታል።
text.en: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.

text.am: እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር በእኛ ላይ አለቃ ነው፥ መለከቱንም የሚነፉ ካህናቱ ከእኛ ጋር ናቸው፥ በእናንተም ላይ ይጮኻሉ። የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ አይበጃችሁምና ከአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አትዋጉ።
text.en: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

text.am: ኢዮርብዓም ግን ድብቅ ጦር በስተ ኋላቸው አዞረ፤ እነርሱ በይሁዳ ፊት ሆነው ድብቅ ጦሩ በስተ ኋላቸው ነበረ።
text.en: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.

text.am: ይሁዳም ወደ ኋላው በተመለከተ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰልፉ በፊቱና በኋላው ነበረ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጮኹ፥ ካህናቱም መለከቱን ነፉ።
text.en: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

text.am: የይሁዳም ሰዎች ጮኹ፤ የይሁዳም ሰዎች በጮኹ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ኢዮርብዓምንና እስራኤልን ሁሉ በአብያና በይሁዳ ፊት መታቸው።
text.en: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

text.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከይሁዳ ፊት ሸሹ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእጃቸው አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።
text.en: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.

text.am: አብያና ሕዝቡ ታላቅ አመታት መቱአቸው፤ ከእስራኤልም አምስት መቶ ሺህ የተመረጡ ሰዎች ተገድለው ወደቁ።
text.en: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

text.am: በዚያም ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ተዋረዱ፥ የይሁዳም ልጆች በአባቶቻቸው አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ታምነው ነበርና አሸነፉ።
text.en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.

text.am: አብያም ኢዮርብዓምን አሳደደው፥ ከእርሱም ከተሞቹን፥ ቤቴልንና መንደሮችዋን፥ ይሻናንና መንደሮችዋን፥ ዔፍሮንንና መንደሮችዋን ወሰደ።
text.en: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.

text.am: ኢዮርብዓምም ከዚያ በኋላ በአብያ ዘመን አልበረታም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ቀሠፈው፥ ሞተም።
text.en: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.

text.am: አብያም ጸና፥ አሥራ አራትም ሚስቶች አገባ፥ ሀያ ሁለትም ወንዶች ልጆችንና አሥራ ስድስት ሴቶች ልጆችን ወለደ።
text.en: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

text.am: የአብያም የቀረው ነገርና አካሄዱ የተናገራቸውም ቃሎች በነቢዩ በአዶ መጽሐፍ ተጽፈዋል።
text.en: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.

text.am: አብያም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም አሳ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ። በእርሱም ዘመን ምድሪቱ አሥር ዓመት ያህል ዐረፈች።
text.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

text.am: አሳም በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካምና ቅን ነገር አደረገ፤
text.en: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:

text.am: የእንግዶቹንም አማልክት መሠዊያ የኮረብታውንም መስገጃዎች አፈረሰ፥ ሐውልቶቹንም ሰበረ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹንም ቈረጠ፤
text.en: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:

text.am: የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ይሹ ዘንድ፥ ሕጉንና ትእዛዙንም ያደርጉ ዘንድ ይሁዳን አዘዘ።
text.en: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.

text.am: ከይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎችና የፀሐይ ምስሎችን አስወገደ፤ መንግሥቱም በእርሱ ሥር በሰላም ተቀመጠች።
text.en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.

text.am: በይሁዳም ምሽጎች ከተሞችን ሠራ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ዕረፍት ስለ ሰጠው ምድሪቱ ጸጥ ብላ ነበር፥ በዚያም ዘመን ሰልፍ አልነበረም።
text.en: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.

text.am: ይሁዳንም። እነዚህን ከተሞች እንሥራ፥ ቅጥርም ግንብም መዝጊያም መወርወሪያም እናድርግባቸው፤ አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ፈለግነው ምድሪቱ ገና በፊታችን ናት፤ እኛ ፈልገነዋል፥ እርሱም በዙሪያችን ዕረፍት ሰጥቶናል አለ። እነርሱም ሠሩ አከናወኑም።
text.en: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.

text.am: ለአሳም አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻና ጦር የሚሸከሙ ሦስት መቶ ሺህ የይሁዳ ሠራዊት፥ ጋሻም የሚሸከሙ ቀስትም የሚገትሩ ሁለት መቶ ሰማኒያ ሺህ የብንያም ሰዎች ነበሩት፤ እነዚህም ሁሉ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ነበሩ።
text.en: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.

text.am: ኢትዮጵያዊውም ዝሪ አንድ ሚሊዮን ሰዎችና ሦስት መቶ ሰረገሎች ይዞ ወጣባቸው፤ ወደ መሪሳም መጣ።
text.en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.

text.am: አሳም ሊጋጠመው ወጣ፥ በመሪሳም አጠገብ ባለው በጽፋታ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ተሰለፉ።
text.en: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

text.am: አሳም። አቤቱ፥ በብዙም ሆነ በጥቂቱ ማዳን አይሳንህም፤ አቤቱ አምላካችን ሆይ፥ በአንተ ታምነናልና፥ በስምህም በዚህ ታላቅ ወገን ላይ መጥተናልና እርዳን፤ አቤቱ፥ አምላካችን አንተ ነህ፤ ሰውም አያሸንፍህ ብሎ ወደ አምላኩ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ።
text.en: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም በአሳና በይሁዳ ፊት ኢትዮጵያውያንን መታ፤ ኢትዮጵያውያንም ሸሹ።
text.en: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

text.am: አሳም ከእርሱም ጋር ያለው ሕዝብ እስከ ጌራራ ድረስ አሳደዱአቸው፤ ኢትዮጵያውያንም ፈጽመው እስኪጠፉ ድረስ ወደቁ፥ በእግዚአብሔርና በሠራዊቱ ፊት ተሰባብረዋልና፤ እጅግም ብዙ ምርኮ ወሰዱ።
text.en: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.

text.am: ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ ታላቅ ድንጋጤ ስለ ወደቀባቸው በጌራራ ዙሪያ የነበሩትን ከተሞች ሁሉ መቱ፤ በከተሞቹም ውስጥ እጅግ ብዝበዛ ነበረና ከተሞቹን ሁሉ በዘበዙ።
text.en: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.

text.am: የከብቶቹንም በረት አፈረሱ፤ እጅግም ብዙ በጎችንና ግመሎችንም ማረኩ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ተመለሱ።
text.en: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በዖዴድ ልጅ በዓዛርያስ ላይ ሆነ፤
text.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

text.am: አሳንም ሊገናኘው ወጣ፥ እንዲህም አለው። አሳ ይሁዳና ብንያም ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ እናንተ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ስትሆኑ እርሱ ከእናንተ ጋር ነው፤ ብትፈልጉትም ይገኝላችኋል፤ ብትተዉት ግን ይተዋችኋል።
text.en: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.

text.am: እስራኤልም ብዙ ዘመን ያለ እውነተኛ አምላክ፥ ያለ አስተማሪም ካህን፥ ያለ ሕግም ይኖሩ ነበር።
text.en: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.

text.am: በመከራቸውም ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመልሰው በፈለጉት ጊዜ አገኙት።
text.en: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.

text.am: በዚያም ዘመን ለሚወጣውና ለሚገባው ሰላም አልነበረም፥ በምድርም በሚኖሩት ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ድንጋጤ ነበረ።
text.en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር በመከራው ሁሉ ያስጨንቃቸው ነበርና ወገን ከወገን ጋር፥ ከተማም ከከተማ ጋር ይዋጋ ነበር።
